title: Tzafnat, Daughter of Peniel the High Priest
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Gittin 58a relates that she was taken captive and her captor abused her all night. The next day he dressed her in seven garments and took her out to sell her, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The whole William Davidson Gittin 58a paragraphs name Tzafnat bat Peniel, daughter of the High Priest, and describe the abuse, seven garments and sale. Hyman’s abridgment and ‘etc.’ are retained without importing the continuation.
